about: The secreta of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Receive, O Lord, we beseech Thee, the gifts of Thy rejoicing Church; and as Thou hast given her cause for so great a joy, grant her the fruit of everlasting gladness. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
